items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: And Margaret Villegas was a professional singer who sang with some name bands, the George Hall band, big band, you know, traveled around the country. She sang under the name of Loretta Lee.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. But did they have an arranger, or did they buy stocks, or?

No, no, it was all stocks and a few specials. Just like streaming operated. Mm-hmm. Streaming operated with 80% stock arrangements and about 20% of special arrangements. Streaming would have 10 or 12 special arrangements, maybe more. Or used to order them out of New York, you know. And Blue Parody was the same way. They played a lot of stocks and a few specials. Well, who did the singing? Oh. In the streaming band we had various singers. Helen, I'm trying to think of her last name. She was Miss New Orleans at one…
